content: {"summary":"After the 19 March 2025 zone push to internal‑dns‑01 the new zone file omitted the database record used by orders‑api, causing intermittent NXDOMAIN responses until the record was restored and the corrected zone pushed with a higher serial, after which cache turnover allowed normal resolution.","likely_cause":"Missing DNS record in the prod.internal zone on internal‑dns‑01 after the March 2025 zone push removed it.","confidence":"high","claims":[{"text":"The zone push removed the database record, leading to intermittent NXDOMAIN lookups from orders‑api.","evidence_ids":["INC-0025#0","INC-0025#1"],"quote":"The new file lacked the record orders-api uses for its database."},{"text":"Restoring the record with a higher serial and repushing the zone cleared the NXDOMAIN errors once cache expired.","evidence_ids":["INC-0025#2","INC-0025#3"],"quote":"The record went back into the zone source with a higher serial, and the corrected file went out"}],"next_checks":["Verify that after any zone push both internal‑dns‑01 and internal‑dns‑02 serve identical zone serials","Monitor CoreDNS cache TTL expiration to ensure stale NXDOMAIN responses clear promptly","Add pre‑push validation to confirm required records (e.g., orders‑api database hostname) are present in the new zone file"]}
